definition: the front desk where guests check in
description: A young woman with a large trekking backpack walks in through the open door of a hostel and up to the front desk, where a member of staff stands behind the counter in a small room lined with leaflets, posters and a drinks fridge. Next she is at a huge painted world map on the wall, laughing as she presses a small marker onto it. She then walks into a dorm room with wooden bunk beds and a locker, greeted by two other travellers on the bunks. Finally she steps onto a rooftop terrace at sunset where friends are sitting at a wooden table, and the group eats a big pan of paella together as the sun goes down over the city.

taps.phrase: to go down over the city
